name: GALFA-Dw4 (Hubble)
blurb: GALFA-Dw4, an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: galfadw4-hubble
story: A small, gas-rich galaxy found through its link to a compact cloud of hydrogen, with no confirmed neighbors nearby. It is unusually compact for its brightness, and a few HII regions holding young star clusters show it is still forming stars.

claims.text: GALFA-Dw4 is classified as a dwarf irregular galaxy
GALFA-Dw4 is isolated, with no confirmed neighbors nearby
GALFA-Dw4 is a gas-rich dwarf found through its association with a compact HI (hydrogen) high velocity cloud
It contains HII regions with young star clusters
Dw4 is unusually compact for a galaxy of its luminosity
Dw4 shows some evidence for current star formation in spatially limited HII regions
